parts.name: Root
parts.description: A native button element. It has pending semantics, and it shows its interaction state in data attributes.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the live render state: hovered,
pressed, focused, and pending.

props.name: pending
props.description: Keeps the button focusable, but stops the activation. It announces the pending state politely.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description:
Keeps a disabled button in the tab order. The button gets `aria-disabled` and not the native
attribute. The component still stops the activation.

Use it for a control that is unavailable more often than available. The move buttons of a
transfer list are one example, and a toolbar that obeys a selection is another. If you disable
those natively, a keyboard user does not find them, and the tab order changes while the user
works. `pending` says "busy". This says "not applicable".

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Replaces the pressed state that the component holds.

dataAttributes.name: data-button-live-region
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the internal polite live region for the pending announcements.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the element has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-pending
dataAttributes.description: Present while the button is pending. The button keeps the focus, but it does not activate.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer or the keyboard presses the button.
